sources.title: Hakijatilastot - Turku AMK
sources.covers: Checked: page offers only applicant-count reports and states that cutoffs (pisterajat) are found in Vipunen; no own cutoff list

sources.title: Turun AMK info toisen asteen opoille

notes: Turku AMK does not publish its own certificate-selection cutoff statistics. Its official Hakijatilastot page (turkuamk.fi/koulutus/hakijan-opas/hakijatilastot/) says that information about pisterajat is in the Vipunen report (Haku- ja valintatiedot - korkeakoulu - pisterajat), and explains how to drill into the first-timer split there. The page itself publishes only applicant-count reports. Searched: WebSearch in Finnish (alin hyväksytty pistemäärä, pisterajat, valintatilasto, alimmat hyväksytyt pisteet, with 2024-2026), a scan of the full turkuamk.fi sitemap (about 2,870 URLs) for piste/tilasto/alin/valintatulos, and the opiskelijavalinta page and counselor info PDF. No 2024, 2025 or 2026 cutoff document was found for the spring or autumn joint application. Third-party sites (yhteishaku.app, valmennuskeskus.fi) were found but not used, by rule.
